name: vite-plugin-lit-forms-example
description: Form-associated custom elements in Lit, for @oddsquad/vite-plugin-lit: a FormControl base class over ElementInternals, and a text field, a switch, a star rating and a tag list holding a Set built on it that take part in a native <form> (FormData, validation, reset, a disabled fieldset) and expose what they are doing as :state() custom states. Rules that span fields are a valibot schema whose issues reach the controls through setCustomValidity(). Opens on StackBlitz straight from the repo URL.
